items.title: Build a timing probe for each TEST-advance step
items.context: story_advance to TEST runs review preflight then validate. A tiny in-process probe should time the same functions the production path uses, without walking a new story through the full lifecycle just to take a measurement.

items.title: Record the bottleneck with wall-clock numbers
items.context: Run the probe and standalone validate flags, then write down which step dominates so a later fix story can target the real cost instead of guessing.
